cohort: 84 premature infants with twin-to-twin transfusion syndrome
finding: Invasive mechanical ventilation, necrotizing enterocolitis, single intrauterine fetal demise, and a 5-minute Apgar score <9 were identified as independent risk factors for brain injury in premature infants with twin-to-twin transfusion syndrome.
mod_finding: While the majority of infants in both the brain injury and non-brain injury groups were delivered via cesarean section, there was no significant difference in rates of cesarean section between the groups.
